actions.minimal_action: Keep common fields and criterion-specific anchors. Require human comparison before ranking.
actions.acceptance_evidence: Parent review of the full v3 matrix and tool dispositions.
actions.decision_effect: No fourth model round; reopen only with changed evidence or requirements.

actions.minimal_action: Use one documented external Cargo build of the native launcher in approved AppData, then runtime-only repeated --bin builds. Cache and lock dependencies before offline acceptance.
actions.acceptance_evidence: Future locked offline build records with sibling outputs and approved paths.
actions.decision_effect: Keep M1 provisional without installer or updater machinery.
actions.residual_risk: Same-release sibling wiring and cache choices can fail.

actions.minimal_action: Port one helper slice at a time and retain rollback to the previous accepted slice.
actions.acceptance_evidence: Native helper, monitor, launcher, and tool tests with dated rollback records.

actions.minimal_action: Share power and monitor modules and keep tooling ports in a separate phase.
actions.acceptance_evidence: Rust tool ports or explicit retire/archive records.
actions.residual_risk: The endpoint still contains many tool ports.

actions.minimal_action: Use the same parent-owned handles, monitor handle, helper handle, partial cleanup, Stop order, and UI-crash gap in both plans.
actions.acceptance_evidence: Future code review and lifecycle tests compare both paths.
actions.decision_effect: Do not use packaging to claim different ownership behavior.
actions.residual_risk: Equivalent plans can still differ in implementation details.

actions.minimal_action: Decide the console-subsystem route and native bootstrap before selecting M2.
actions.acceptance_evidence: Direct UI, hidden modes, manual helper, and launcher checks.

actions.minimal_action: Keep M3 conditional while external observation and current pane meaning remain required.
actions.acceptance_evidence: Product scope decision plus new cancellation, panic, and pane tests.
actions.residual_risk: In-process cancellation and panic ownership remain open.

actions.weakness: Hermes implementation and ownership boundary unknown
actions.minimal_action: Port owned task-ranker sources to a small Rust tool crate proposal and inspect Hermes ownership before claiming a Python-free workflow.
actions.acceptance_evidence: Tool decision ledger and Hermes evidence.
actions.decision_effect: No claim that the whole developer workflow is Python-free.
actions.residual_risk: An external CLI may remain outside repository control.

actions.weakness: Stop kills monitor before helper and does not guarantee STOPPED
actions.minimal_action: Preserve the order and test the actual log outcomes. Treat monitor output as process liveness only.
actions.acceptance_evidence: Future Stop, heartbeat, and cleanup records.
actions.decision_effect: Do not promise a final STOPPED record.
actions.residual_risk: Forced kill can skip child cleanup.

actions.weakness: All native implementation and tool-port acceptance is unrun
actions.minimal_action: Run future helper, monitor, launcher, and tool tests only after implementation, with no new capture work.
actions.acceptance_evidence: Dated test records and final source hashes.
actions.residual_risk: Windows behavior may differ from the plan.
